segments.name: Construction
products: design and build of all sorts of public and private works
segments.description: Designs and builds public and private works, most notably public infrastructures, for public and private sector customers.
segments.evidence: Construction, which undertakes the design and build of all sorts of public and private works, including most notably the construction of public infrastructures.

segments.name: Highways
products: development, financing and operation of highways
segments.description: Develops, finances and operates highways, earning revenue from infrastructure users and public administrations under concession agreements.
segments.evidence: Highways, which carries out the development, financing and operation of highways.

segments.name: Airports
segments.description: Develops, finances and operates airports, serving airlines and airport users through short-term services.
segments.evidence: Airports, which is engaged in developing, financing and operating airports.

segments.name: Energy
products: promotion, construction and operation of energy generation and transmission infr
segments.description: Promotes, builds and operates energy generation and transmission infrastructures, providing construction and operation services to customers.
segments.evidence: Energy, which focuses on innovative solutions for the promotion, construction and operation of energy generation and transmission infrastructures.

revenueModel.text: Infrastructure users and public administrations pay for the construction, operation and maintenance of infrastructure under concession and service contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: In the case of contracts classified as intangible assets, the customer is the infrastructure user and therefore each use of the infrastructure by users is deemed a performance obligation and the revenue is recognized at a point in time.

changes.text: In 2023 the Construction Business line and the Energy Infrastructures business line were merged into the Energy Business line.
changes.evidence: From this point onwards, the resulting business line is named the Energy Business line, and consequently, the comparable information related to segment reporting (Note 1.5) has been prepared accordingly.

changes.text: In January 2025 the company completed the sale of its entire stake in AGS Airports.
changes.evidence: Furthermore, on January 28, 2025, we completed the sale of our entire stake in AGS Airports.

changes.text: The company divested its stake in Heathrow airport, completing the sale of the remaining stake in 2025.
changes.evidence: on February 26, 2025, we announced that a binding agreement had been reached for the sale of that 5.25% remaining stake.
